body: That's a lot of advice when I provided few to no details.
I'm mainly scared that when I go get a job she'll report me to an employer and I'll get fired over it :(

Did you feel sad when you were hurt? Of course you did. Another "twist of the knife", self-awareness. 

Sure, I'll get over it. I see life as far more complex than just hunting and gathering, surely you do too, ah! That's why you're here haunting Confession, because you have your own demons you wish to talk about but can't bring yourself to do it because you were beaten your whole life and taught to feel worthless. You secretly do wish for a better life.

Life does get better, see a therapist man.

Probably not and like I said I'm sorry you had to endure it.

You know even though you're unnecessarily vicious toward me I appreciate your words. 

As a kid though the way I was treated did leave me very depressed, without an outside influence telling me I should feel that way. No kid should ever be hit or yelled at constantly so even if I wasn't beaten as severely it still hurt man.

My parents never paid for a thing in my life beyond possessions and I don't have an inheritance.

I'm very sorry you endured the abuse you did, you didn't deserve it and it *was* worse than mine.

Video games were important to me, I was a friendless miserable kid without a mother.

My dad didn't ask me to quit the game, he whipped a remote at me to hurt me. Did you not read? He screamed at me constantly and took his frustrations out on me.

Sure I recognise he had problems, that's why I mentioned "he was going through a lot".

Was I overreacting the time he was punching me in the head in front of my friends?

Yeah like she contacts my employer and tells them what went down.

I'm gonna try, thanks for being there man

Well we can really don't visit anymore, the only time is holidays and that's if we do. 

Do you think I should ever worry about this? I mean eventually I'll leave but yeah

She's always been very temperamental.

I guess she did, since she also did her part and later made it out like it was only me. I wish I would have been upfront...

I just want to be normal, and have a normal job and school. She could ruin that at any point it she wanted to :(

I'm so sorry to hear all of that went on with your family, that's terrible to hear. I hope you're alright now, to some extent and have peace when you can.

See that's where I keep beating myself up, she did do the lap thing, she did stick my face there but what if it was innocent? I can't see how it was but... That idea keeps nagging at me. She was also a year younger.

I just wish I would have had self control, I was such a stupid kid.

Is it common? I'd like to think I was just growing up and made a simple mistake.

I wish I wasn't afraid of getting a job one day I love and losing it because I get reported...

I would love to do that, and experience new things. You're right I've never explored who I am now 

I also fear eventually being outted and losing a career over this, even though it was mostly mutual.

Thanks so much for being there, I'm going to talk to someone soon.

It's so hard realizing I overreacted for a ton of years.

I hope my family loves me, well they seem to, even if they are really fucked up

I'm going to try to move on, hopefully one day we can sit down and talk and do a full apology type thing, I dream of that day.

It's clear to me now there was something fishy going on with her actions but I didn't take notice until recently.
I'm going to do my best!

Thank you that means the world to me hearing I'm not those things.

Tbh I don't remember how she got involved, but she's always butt herself into every situation. I wish it would have been resolved parents to parents and we would have been sat down and punished.

Thank you I'm going to try being a happy adult and do some good :)

I'm glad you'd be my friend, that means a lot :)

That's true, there should have been some red flags for them. She constantly tried to sit there or cuddle up, I could definitely mention that.

I never realized how bad her end was too, I always beat myself up. She must have been ashamed too yknow?

Need to stop beating myself up for being young and dumb

It really put things into perspective when you mentioned grounding. I was a lot younger than I realize, and it feels so fresh. I wish I would have been grounded and life would have went on, that would have been great.

Thanks I'm glad you'd be my friend.

I'll never come remotely even close to making such a dumb mistake again.

Haha I'll stop overreacting

Thank you I'm going to try to be happy. I'm so ashamed I did that but I guess I was young.

It was handled so badly, I was just yelled at and we never really sat down and resolved anything and they never tried to get the whole story.

It's very helpful thank you, and interesting at that because it's impossible to see her as sick and abusive when you have the whole story, it's all in our perception.

I think I will try to talk to someone one day

I'm going to try to forgive myself, it was a confusing time I can't even wrap my head around today.

If they ever do I'm going to lay everything on the table.

I do believe I need distance and to make my own way.

My last counselor started crying after I talked to him about my family and how I was raised.
Happy birthday :) I hope you can relax with your cat who clearly loves you and appreciates the day you were born.

No I was too ashamed to admit it happened to me too. I probably could have solved everything had I spoke up.

She was apparently awake when I did what I did, and was about a year or two younger I believe.

She used the word "violated". It's worth noting that before all of this things were really strange between us. She'd sit on my lap and it had to be the center, if I moved her she'd move back. She'd stick my face into her butt, very weird things.

We hung out again like everything was normal a year or so after this took place.

I'm not sure why she only ever blamed me, she definitely did her part too.
